iti100:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti100:2.1: “I am a brahman, monks, always responsive to requests, open-handed, bearing my last body, an unsurpassed doctor & surgeon.
iti100:2.2: You are my children, my sons, born from my mouth, born of the Dhamma, created by the Dhamma, heirs to the Dhamma, not heirs in material things.
iti100:3.1: “There are these two kinds of gifts:
iti100:3.2: a gift of material things & a gift of the Dhamma.
iti100:3.3: Of these two kinds of gifts, this is supreme: a gift of the Dhamma.
iti100:4.1: “There are these two kinds of sharing:
iti100:4.2: sharing of material things & sharing of the Dhamma.
iti100:4.3: Of these two kinds of sharing, this is supreme: sharing of the Dhamma.
iti100:5.1: “There are these two kinds of assistance:
iti100:5.2: assistance with material things & assistance with the Dhamma.
iti100:5.3: Of these two kinds of assistance, this is supreme: assistance with the Dhamma. “There are these two kinds of mass-donations:
iti100:6.1: a mass-donation of material things & a mass-donation of the Dhamma.
iti100:6.3: Of these two kinds of mass-donations, this is supreme: a mass-donation of the Dhamma.”
iti100:7.2: the Tathāgata, sympathetic to all beings:
iti100:7.3: to one of that sort –the best of beings, human & divine– living beings pay homage–
iti100:7.4: to one gone to the beyond of becoming.
